title: Deshil Holles Eamus. Deshil Holles Eamus. Deshil Holles Eamus.
html_source:
Deshil – the phonetic pronunciation of the Gaelic deiseal or deisil – from Old Irish dess (“right, south”) + sel (“turn”).

Holles refers to Holles street.

Eamus is latin for “Let us go”

Essentially: Let us turn south to Holles street.

There are a total of nine repetitions.

PROPOSED SUGGESTION: A general improvement would be pagination of the text for referencing
